Type: glass shelf etagere
Use: displaying books and decor; living room, dining room, home office
Style: contemporary, modern, minimalist
Materials: solid oak frame in dark stain, glass shelves, metal cross braces
Colors: dark espresso brown, clear glass, silver
Shape: tall open frame with square posts, five glass shelves, X-braced sides, no back, light and airy
Feel: refined, airy, elegant
Goes with: white walls, chrome, neutral fabrics; contemporary rooms

product.name: Pinzon Jonesport Solid Oak and Glass Shelf
product.description: Beautiful modern hardwood and glass shelf offers great storage and display spaces Solid oak frame with 8mm glass shelves; holds up to 30 pounds per shelf Open front and sides for easy accessibility; arrives ready to assemble Coordinates with the Pinzon Jonesport Office Furniture Collection; kona brown finish Measures 28 inches wide by 16-1/2 inches deep by 65-1/4 inches high
